title: Trump Reportedly Weighs Hegseth's Exit as Iran War Fallout Deepens After Midterm Losses
detail: Headline-level report: President Trump is reportedly weighing the departure of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth as fallout from the Iran war deepens following Republican midterm losses. No further detail was available in the feed; the report is unconfirmed.

title: Russia Reportedly to Supply Iran with 90 Helicopter-Mounted Missile Launchers
detail: Kyiv Post reports Russia is set to supply Iran with 90 helicopter-mounted missile launchers of a type used in the Ukraine war. Headline-level report via aggregator; not independently confirmed.

title: Hegseth Defends Iran War, Pushes for $350 Billion in Military Funding
detail: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended the Iran war and pressed for $350 billion in military funding, per a headline-level report via aggregator. Details not independently confirmed.

title: Trump Says Iran Is 'Not Doing Anything' on Nuclear Programme Without US Approval
detail: Per a Middle East Eye live blog, President Trump said Iran is 'not doing anything' on its nuclear programme without US approval. Claim is Trump's own statement and not independently verified.
